### Pride Doesn’t Always Parade
Author: Marshall Segal
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/pride-doesnt-always-parade
Passage: Numbers 15:32-36
Points:
- The man was executed not for an innocent misunderstanding, but for deliberate, willful defiance of God's explicit command.
- Positioned right after the warning against high-handed sins, his actions demonstrated an arrogant dismissal of God's authority.
- Pride does not always parade loudly in public; it often works quietly through ordinary tasks and domestic chores.
- True faith surrenders self-reliance to rest and work according to God's wisdom and timing.
